section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant characteristics of a study with 309 Portuguese women from the general population, aged 18-50 years (M=23.00). Participants had a mean of 13.54 years of education and a mean BMI of 22.28, indicating a normal-weighted sample with the majority (77.35%) in the normal weight category.
